display_name: Snapdeal implementation — Net TDS Deducted (after reversals)
filters: Use exactly the filters in formula_sql / linked sql_pattern, especially is_active=true, transaction_type/type scope, and group_level_id column scope where runtime supplies it.
formula_sql:
SELECT
  SUM(gross_amount) AS net_tds_deducted,
  SUM(CASE WHEN gross_amount < 0 THEN gross_amount ELSE 0 END) AS gross_tds_deducted,
  SUM(CASE WHEN gross_amount > 0 THEN gross_amount ELSE 0 END) AS tds_reversed
FROM zs_observe.snapdeal_non_order
WHERE is_active = true;
